packageGuidance.rule: Every package develops one approved Marketing Direction. Each role must approach that direction from its own purpose rather than summarizing the full ServSync feature inventory.
differentiationChecks: no repeated request-to-estimate-to-job-to-invoice summary unless the role specifically requires it

recipes.purpose: Introduce ServSync to small service contractors through one focused direction expressed by distinct content roles.

items.directionPurpose: Open with a realistic contractor/customer moment and one immediate practical benefit.
Develop the business philosophy or relationship value behind the direction without repeating the scenario post.
Explain the central distinction or choice clearly in plain language.
Demonstrate one specific current ServSync interaction that supports the direction.
Show the direction visually through a short sequence that is not a narrated feature list.

recipes.purpose: Explain one practical home-service organization idea without implying automated maintenance or guaranteed contractor outcomes.

items.directionPurpose: Explain one useful home-service concept in plain homeowner language.
Start from one recognizable homeowner problem and connect it to one current ServSync benefit.
Demonstrate one current homeowner interaction that supports the direction.
Focus on the optional ongoing contractor relationship without promising leads, response, or automatic sharing.
Show one homeowner story visually without turning it into a complete product tour.

recipes.purpose: Explain one currently marketable ServSync capability through distinct, audience-relevant angles.

items.directionPurpose: State what the current capability enables and why it matters without competitor contrast.
Describe one contractor situation improved by the capability.
Describe one homeowner or customer choice supported by the capability.
Clarify the capability's scope and boundaries in normal language.
Demonstrate the capability through one short visual story rather than a feature inventory.
